alex_sales: Heads-up — Enterprise POC kickoff with NovaHealth tomorrow. They signed an initial commit but have lots of Qs on reserved GPUs, autoscale, and the security questionnaire. Can SE/Infra help outline a plan?

lee_se: Quick summary of their traffic: peak 2k RPS for chat embed endpoints (mixed short/long), average payload ~250 tokens, bursty spikes up to 10k rps for <2 minutes. They want p99 <700ms for chat gen.

jamie_infra: For that shape I'd recommend reserved pool + autoscale hedge. Baseline: reserve 8 GPUs (A100 equivalent) with autoscale min=2 max=16, burst credits for short spikes. That gives steady throughput and headroom for spikes.

alex_sales: Budget question — what does 8 reserved GPUs + burst look like vs fully on-demand? Customer asked for pricing delta to justify commit.

taylor_fin: Rough estimate: 8-reserved monthly commit gives ~35% discount vs on-demand for GPU hours. Add burst credit package (~100k token bursts) at a small premium. I'll run exact numbers if you confirm the model/instance sizing.

lee_se: Also call out KV warmup. Their chat uses long context and we should preheat KV cache to avoid p99 tail spikes. Plan: preheat windows 30m before peak and maintain prefix cache for top 20 prompts.

jamie_infra: Ops notes: preheat job command we use in POCs — run on the customer namespace:```sh
rbw preheat --namespace novahealth --kv-prefixes top20 --duration 1800
```
This populates KV and warms model weights with a low-QPS fan to avoid cold starts.

rachel_sec: From security: NovaHealth needs KMS integration (customer-managed), SOC2 attestation, and an encrypted audit trail. They also sent a 40-question vendor questionnaire — I've started answering but need infra flags for KMS/HSM and network isolation (VPC).

alex_sales: @rachel_sec can you list the exact infra answers you need so we can get Jamie to confirm?

rachel_sec: Need strings for: "KMS: supported (customer key yes/no)", "Private control plane: yes/no", "Audit logs retention options", "Data residency/region support", "On-prem/offline install options". Also need an SLA excerpt for reserved pool latency.

jamie_infra: We support KMS with BYOK (customer-managed keys) and HSM-backed keys for Private deployments. Private control plane is possible for their enterprise tier. Audit logs: configurable retention 30/90/365 days. Regions: NA/EU currently, APAC planned Q3. SLA excerpt: dedicated pools aim for 99.9% uptime and latency SLOs per route (we can attach the doc).

lee_se: For the POC smoke test propose: 1) 1-hour ramp to 50% of peak sustained (1k RPS) to validate throughput and qps shaping, 2) 15-minute 10k rps spike to validate burst credits and autoscale fallback, 3) KV warmup before step 2.

alex_sales: Can we get runbook checklist for the POC that I can share with the customer? Short, bullet style.

jamie_infra: Runbook (short):
- Reserve 8 GPUs in customer namespace
- Configure autoscale policy min=2 max=16, scale step=2, cooldown=30s
- Provision burst credits 100k tokens
- Schedule `rbw preheat` 30m before tests
- Apply VPC peering + KMS BYOK config
- Monitor: tokens/sec, tail latency p95/p99, model OOMs
- Fallback policy: route to quantized variant on capacity pressure

lee_se: Also add telemetry hooks: enable per-route tracing + token-level cost breakdown for the POC so customer can correlate cost vs quality.

taylor_fin: I'll draft the pricing delta (reserved vs on-demand + burst addon) and a 3-month runway plan for commit sizes. Expect numbers within 24h.

rachel_sec: I'll complete the questionnaire entries tied to the infra responses and add SOC2 artifact links. One ask from legal: an excerpt confirming no persistent PHI stored by Redwood. Can someone confirm?

jamie_infra: Confirm — we do not persist customer prompts beyond retention window; platform can be configured to not retain logs and to redact where required. We'll provide a short statement.

alex_sales: Awesome. Any blockers before I send the package to NovaHealth?

lee_se: Request: get a sample traffic trace (minute-level rps/latency) and a representative set of top-20 prompts. That lets us size KV prefixes and validate model variant choice.

alex_sales: I'll ask the customer for the trace and prompts now. Thanks everyone 🙏 :rocket: 

deploy-bot: Preheat job queued for staging namespace (job id: preheat-20240216-77) — will post status updates.

jamie_infra: FYI: if we need extra headroom during POC, we can temporarily spin up an extra 4 GPUs for the day (cost passed to customer) — link me and I'll schedule.
